id.symbol: code edit invalidates VBA project signature

rationale: Modify-invalidates is doc-stated for workbook-content signatures, not for VBA project signatures; Office may silently re-sign on save when the cert is present. Advice kept, basis labeled.

No Learn statement on expiry behaviour for VBA project signatures; a timestamped signature can survive cert expiry in general code-signing, so the blanket claim may overstate. Hedged rather than asserted.

id.symbol: add-in procedures callable with no reference

rationale: True for worksheet UDFs and Application.Run (docs: macro names need not be qualified), but calling add-in procedures from another project's VBA code does require a reference. Sentence scoped accordingly.
